entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: Organizing context as a virtual filesystem via viking:// URIs, this database utilizes three-tier loading to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains. It features observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling through connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Designed for multi-user team environments with scoped access, this system provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It functions as an agent brain centered around a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers. It offers flexible deployment options including Docker, Kubernetes, and dedicated Python or Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by extracting conclusions from conversations through background reasoning processes. It supports session and peer management via Python and TypeScript SDKs, available through managed hosting or a FastAPI server.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this tool manages context trees using git-like versioning for commits, branches, and merges. It features a 5-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms speeds and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system utilizes a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory operations for local storage. It achieves sub-linear storage growth through episodic compression and supports MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It relies on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness uses outcome-gated promotion to manage context bundles and prompt selection for complex tasks. It generates traces, playbooks, and local-model training artifacts while supporting Python, TypeScript, and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This backend enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by wrapping the Honcho library for self-hosted environments. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable data locally for multi-agent systems. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents via MCP and specialized plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to enhance prefix reuse. These optimizations reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that avoids vector databases in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. Its five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore for durable local storage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single stack. It manages state and retrieval through SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local-first cache. Built for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, it utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server for coding agents.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory for coding agents by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores data as inspectable Markdown files and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache to avoid opaque databases.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory for agents through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only necessary context, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. This local-first layer exposes context via MCP-native stdio or SSE servers without requiring external accounts.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by applying local BM25 ranking to tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: Designed as a Git-backed workflow layer, this tool stores durable context and chat archives in plain Markdown files. It facilitates source-neutral migrations for coding agents and uses host-specific adapters to manage setup and execution commands.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools for semantic search and state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across ten chain families, including EVM and Solana. It allows APIs and agents to autonomously manage payments with a few lines of TypeScript code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing, organizing scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations for agent use. It supports graph neighbor traversal for artifact retrieval and uses opt-in implicit feedback to optimize routing.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for all stored data. It offers flexible execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon and utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory by indexing repositories through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools to support semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A within codebases.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This database-free kit uses a git-backed directory of Markdown files to manage memory hygiene through versioned, diffable updates. It includes specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale or conflicting data to propose evidence-cited corrections.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously. It enforces a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development to ensure reliable software creation.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables design and prototyping via a CLI compatible with Hermes Agent and 26 other executables. It features a sandboxed iframe for live iterations and exports artifacts into formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, compatible with over 26 AI platforms. Each skill is mapped to industry frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and the NIST AI RMF.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets and features self-check capabilities to automatically fix errors in the output.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. It integrates escrow, x402 payments, and dispute resolution into a single router for secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It is compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, offering modes for detection, rewriting, and in-place editing.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project uses an Agentic Evolver to facilitate the collective evolution and merging of skills across multiple agents. It provides a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and supports Hermes alongside OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This library offers spec-conformant plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a dedicated documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code for various work and life tasks. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for use in other assistants like Gemini, Cursor, and ChatGPT.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and requires a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation to streamline the creation of new agent capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical prompts and thinking instructions tailored to specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built domain lenses to report findings alongside an assessment of potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that include instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the conversion of rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. The workflow includes Lite and Full complexity modes and features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory backed by files or SQLite. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards to support cross-feature learning and plan-approve-execute workflows.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project provides capabilities for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, as well as specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community with installation guides and skills formatted for the agentskills.io standard in Portuguese. it provides localized resources to support the configuration and use of Hermes Agent.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration patterns and prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. The collection includes specialized video skills designed for creating product ads and cinematic inserts.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer documentation into version-pinned skills with full audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and requires Python 3.10 and Node.js 22 or higher.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with support for recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, as well as commerce capabilities using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It incorporates built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a four-verb workflow language that audits AI intents for costs, permissions, and types before execution. It generates hash-chained receipts to verify and replay runs, providing a local-first, verifiable execution layer for agents.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon to maintain persistent connections and incrementally discover server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and integrates federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles, including exploitability and integration impact. It combines deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with sandbox execution to verify findings.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system where an agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a local SQLite database. It connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and focuses on local data storage without cloud synchronization.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and scores prompts across five distinct quality dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides session management and worktree recovery to maintain memory and state between agent conversations. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding tools for developing new skills.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes with 2,077 total skills and 131+ tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks to address real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables Hermes to generate reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to create optimized demo GIFs. It automatically embeds these rendered files into a repository's README while ensuring they remain under the 8 MB limit.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles to prevent technical drift. It monitors official frontmatter specs weekly and uses CI-friendly exit codes to report inconsistencies.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows Hermes to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools, facilitating seamless integration with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the OpenClaw ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing skill structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It allows Hermes to verify existing project-compatible interpreters and handle environment-specific path syntax.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables Hermes to participate in a decentralized support bounty board where payments are settled in USDC on the Base network. It requires no accounts or API keys, allowing users to list bounties or earn rewards through human-approved answers.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales, from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and provides AI-driven analysis with actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides Hermes with specialized utilities for video-to-text extraction, private local OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It includes tools for processing Douyin files and creating batch marketing assets with brand overlays.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide Hermes with structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with various AI agents and editors.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, which are automatically updated on a daily basis. It offers a specialized deployment path for users who manage their software environments through the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This solution features a one-line automated installer for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and integration with both local Ollama models and various cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows using Custom Resource Definitions.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This project provides a one-command installer to deploy Hermes on both Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It extends the agent's utility with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This deployment option focuses on hardware-enforced sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell to secure the Hermes Agent. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker-based sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and supports building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora serves as a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It provides management features such as per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for declarative and reproducible Hermes deployments. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles or sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple Hermes instances from a single web application. It supports RBAC-controlled workspaces, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project facilitates headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable deployment package allows Hermes to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and Git to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework coordinates specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis to execute financial trades. It features a Portfolio Manager for final transaction approval and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through Web UI, CLI, and REST interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be deployed locally via Node.js or through Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, by utilizing git worktrees for task isolation. Users can monitor agents via a TUI or web dashboard with optional sandboxing through Docker and Podman.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling from single VPS agents to automated teams, this template uses a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This project utilizes a level-based architecture to scale Hermes Agent from individual instances to orchestrated specialist teams. It implements a task bus for handoffs and provides built-in skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage delegation within agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of tasks throughout the specialized agent network.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents divided into two competing AI companies. It uses Hermes Agent and Paperclip for task execution, visualizing code and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server. It reduces token usage and tool calls by offering pre-indexed insights for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust projects.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage and costs for Hermes and other AI coding agents. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and supports data submission to a public leaderboard for performance profiling.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI-based tools. It generates self-contained HTML reports for session analysis and automatically redacts authentication headers to ensure security.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting AI providers. It assists developers in building better user interfaces by providing structured architectural constraints.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical session breakdowns to monitor AI tool efficiency.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to streamline app development with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables visual customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to create personalized aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent agent-driven changes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It allows Hermes agents to register human-readable handles and conduct commerce using USDC and SOL on the Solana network.

It supports various frameworks including CrewAI and LangGraph to enhance agent persistence.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining localized skills, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations and tool descriptions using HERM v1.1 scoring to flag overlapping descriptions and inconsistent schemas. It performs deterministic local checks and integrates with GitHub Actions, pre-commit hooks, and SARIF output formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and manages the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and barge-in functionality. It operates locally across 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue via Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for all external actions and utilizing a bounded JSON adapter.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform solution for handling configurations across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full local file access. It integrates multiple external agents, including Hermes Agent, and supports remote interaction through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience by providing guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It includes a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard functions as a local control plane for managing profiles, models, and credentials. It features a visual node-based workflow builder and unified configuration for ten communication channels, including WhatsApp and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a file browser, Monaco editor, and PTY terminal for direct interaction. It features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside a dedicated memory browser and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and an opt-in controller for executing approved browser tab actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It distinguishes itself with an MCP server lifecycle manager and the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit designed to aggregate searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 different agent sources. It focuses on local privacy and resource management by tracking per-session quota burn for Codex and Claude models without telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace provides a direct interface for managing Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated agent installation and integrates a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It is specifically designed for oversight, featuring an approval inbox for agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project offers a terminal-based alternative for interacting with Hermes Agent using OpenTUI. It combines session management with a kanban board for task tracking and provides tools to manage agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that brings Hermes Agent functionality to the Telegram Mini App platform. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or administrative rights to run. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers and supports connections to both cloud and local AI models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and chat capabilities for self-hosted Hermes instances. It includes an integrated file browser and dedicated management panels for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard allows users to track session activity and costs in real time. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration while allowing full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming for interactive agent management. It features an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native model switching with streaming responses.
